faq.q: Can you feel happy and sad at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. You can feel happy about something new and sad about what you are leaving, like on the last day of school. This is called having mixed feelings.
asks: Can I feel two feelings at once?

faq.q: Why do I feel confused when I have mixed feelings?
faq.a: It can feel strange when two feelings seem to pull in different directions. Naming both, like "I feel excited and nervous", helps them make sense.
asks: Why are my feelings so confusing?

faq.q: What should I do with mixed feelings?
faq.a: Name each feeling, remember that both can be true, and talk to someone you trust. You do not have to choose just one.
asks: How do I handle feeling two ways?

faq.q: When do people have mixed feelings?
faq.a: Often at big moments: birthdays, the end of a holiday, moving home, a new baby in the family, or saying goodbye to a friend.
Saudade is a Portuguese word for a deep, sweet-and-sad longing for someone or something you love and miss. It is famous for being hard to translate.

facts: The Portuguese word saudade describes a mix of love and sadness when you miss someone or something, and it is famous for being hard to translate.
In a 2001 study, students moving out of university housing often said they felt happy and sad at the same time.
